title: Hai teri wafao'n ki ajab ghazi kahani
body:
Aye alam daar e wafa.. (2)
aye baab e hawaij
Kehti hai azadaar ki ashko ki rawani
matam ki hai awaaz, tapakta hua paani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan pe sakina ke fida kar di jawani
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
1. Abbas kabhi kuch bhi nahi maanga hai tum ne
jab mashk chhidi tumne dua maangi ye rab se
aajaye isi waqt, agar maut hai aani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sarwar ne kaha jung nahi karni hai bhaiyya
yu hukm pe shabbir ke sar tumne jhukaya
aati hi nahi jaise tumhe tegh chalani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Bhai ko sadaa aaqa kaha bhai na bola
bachpan mein yehi wada to madar se kiya tha
har baat ghulamo ki tarha bhai ki maani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hairaan wafa hogayi jab dekha ye manzar
tum pyaase palat aaye ho darya mein utar kar
aasan thi jis waqt bohot pyaas bujhani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sar aap ka rehwaar ki gesu mein bandha tha
naize pe bulandi bhi nahi tujh ko gawara
sar shaah ke aage na uthane ki hai thaani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai arsalan o meesam ye soch ke rote
zakhmo se lahu aise bahaa ghazi tumhare
jis tarha baha mashk e sakina se tha paani
<<MINI>>
Hai teri wafao ki ajab ghazi kahani..
